Read: the card body and its five comments, the PR body and its three files against merge base `0b539b6a`, ruling 7178358629 (on #36882) with the analysis section it executes (7178076533, "Execution after the ruling (A)"), and the check-runs on this head. The renderer, the spec and the ratchet header were read on `main` at `57ab0876`; `list-views.md` is byte-identical there to the merge base (17792 bytes), and `main`'s two later ratchet rows are other files.

This PASS is the design verdict; the seat adopting it still owes a read of those runs once they conclude.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged. No schema, validator or renderer file is in the diff; `SelectOption.color` stays `z.string().optional()` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`). Right.
- Public surface: one published skill paragraph (+4 lines, 0 deleted, 17792 to 18039 bytes) and one ratchet row. The skill now states a behaviour `main` already has since #36882; it widens nothing an author may write. Right.
- Ratchet row: 4448 to 4510. `ceil(18039 / 4)` is 4510, the base row was at zero headroom (17792 / 4 is 4448 exactly), so the +62 is the measured delta and the row is pinned at the measurement. Right. Authority is judged in ④.
- No eval fixture is added. The card names no eval prompt and the change adds no protocol member, so none was owed.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/skills` patch. That is the package that ships `skills/**`, and a teaching sentence with no behaviour change is a patch. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on both the PR body and the changeset match the diff: nothing is accepted or refused that was not before. The ruling's "changeset minor" in term (5) priced the renderer change of #36882 and does not bind this follow-up. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation, five dist-reading gate families not measured locally: accepted, CI carries them; they were pending at this read (see above).
- Dev deviation, ratchet raised with no same-file deletion: answered in ④, allowed.
- Dev deviation, shared file with PR 37947 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, a different row): accepted. The head is 9 behind `main`; `main`'s changes to that script since the merge base touch the `objectstack-ai` and `objectstack-ask` rows only.
- Dev deviation, renderer read from the tree and not from the #37427 merge commit: accepted, and repeated here on `main`.
- `open_questions`: none.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no query or data-access code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, the four added lines against the code on `main`:

- "coloured only when its option declares `color`": holds. `getBadgeColorClasses(color, _value)` in `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` never consults the value; an undeclared option gets `NEUTRAL_BADGE_CLASSES`. Every other surface that colours a select badge goes through the same two functions with the option's `color`: `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (group rows), `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` (both call sites), `plugin-list/src/conditions/FilterValuePanel.tsx`, and the cell renderer itself. No value-derived table or hash remains.
- The nine names: `BADGE_COLOR_MAP` keys exactly `gray`, `red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `blue`, `indigo`, `purple`, `pink`, in that order. `resolveColorName` passes those through and nothing else by name (`teal` and `amber`, which the data skill lists for object tiles, render neutral here, so the enumeration is load-bearing).
- "or a `#` hex": holds. `getBadgeHexAppearance` paints a declared hex exactly; `resolveColorName` sends a `#` value to the nearest family where a caller does not ask for the exact path.
- "Any other option renders neutral": holds for no declaration, an unknown name, a wrong-case name and an unparseable hex.
- The option shape `{ value: 'won', label: 'Won', color: 'green' }` is valid against `SelectOption` (`label` and `value` required, `color` optional string, lowercase value).
- Against the card: acceptance 1 is stated in full. Acceptance "remove or correct text implying automatic colouring": `skills/objectstack-ui` on `main` carries no line on select option colour, so there was nothing to correct.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, the raise against the gate's own rules:

- The header gives a raise two routes. The standing 2026-10-27 route needs a same-file deletion of restatement. The other is the clause "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta". This PR takes the second, and the PR body quotes the ruling.
- Ruling 7178358629 term (5) reads "`Skills-docs:` a line that colour is declared via `color`", and the ruling executes analysis 7178076533 section "Execution after the ruling (A)", whose item 2 names the place: "a line in `skills/objectstack-ui`". That is a maintainer ruling of record ordering this text into the published skill. Allowed under the clause as written. The ruling names the skill, not the file; earlier rows of this map apply the same clause to rulings that order text "into the published skills", so the reading has precedent, and Column Features in `list-views.md` is where the badge is rendered.
- "Its own measured delta and no more": the added text is the ordered statement with the values that make it actionable, as the card's acceptance spells them (family name or hex, undeclared neutral). Nothing else rides along. +62 matches the bytes.
- Same-file deletion: not owed on this route. The 10402 principle is respected at one sentence. This review did not audit the whole file for unrelated restatement, and the PR's "nothing to cut" claim covers colour text only; that would matter on the standing route, not on this one.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; left as accepted deviations, since a fix in the gate script moves the head):

- N1 (nit): the row comment says "17790 to 18039 bytes (+249)" (its arrow spelled out here). The file at the merge base is 17792 bytes, as the PR body says, so the delta is +247. The pinned number and the +62 are unaffected.
- N2 (nit): the row comment says term (5) "orders this line into `skills/objectstack-ui`". Term (5) itself names no directory; the place comes from the analysis section the ruling executes. The PR body states it accurately.
- N3 (nit): "a `#` hex" means 3 or 6 hex digits (`hexBadgePalette.ts`, `hexToPaletteName`). An 8-digit hex with alpha renders neutral, which "any other option" covers without saying so.
- N4 (nit): the inline option example repeats a shape `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` already shows; about 12 tokens that a later pass on this file could reclaim.

     code agree with the contract, sentence by sentence? Read the cited code in the live tree, and try to
     break the design.
     Grade each finding must-fix, should-fix or nit — a nit has no effect on correctness or the contract.
     A must-fix is a FAIL; a must-fix or should-fix earns a delta review of its fix; nits alone end the round.
     Spell a must-fix or should-fix with its id and grade, `S1 (should-fix) — …`, and a clean round as
     `No must-fix, no should-fix.`: the queue guard reads a graded finding as OPEN on this head and
